Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The agent made a fundamental factual error in the "Updated Understanding" section. In DNA, cytosine (C) pairs with guanine (G), not uracil. Uracil (U) is found in RNA and pairs with adenine. The agent incorrectly stated that cytosine pairs with uracil in DNA, leading to the wrong final answer (A) instead of the correct answer (C).
